quarterly_data.quarter: Luxshare investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its AI-server high-speed connectors and thermal-management components have all reached mass-production shipments to customers, and it is pre-researching next-generation technology for customers' projects. Revenue from thermal-management products is included in the 'communications and data center' revenue category of its periodic reports, a business it says keeps developing well as AI compute infrastructure demand rises.

quarterly_data.quarter: Luxshare investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: overseas bases in Vietnam and elsewhere are advancing according to customer demand, local conditions and capacity plans, with some projects entering construction, introduction and capacity ramp. In automotive electronics, its integration of Leoni (supply-chain coordination, global customer expansion, smart manufacturing) is progressing better than expected. In AI compute it keeps increasing R&D and capacity investment in high-speed optical-electrical interconnect, thermal management and power, and some of this business is accelerating into customer introduction. Consumer electronics remains an important base while automotive and communications / data center grow faster; individual customers' revenue shares will change with business development.
